text:
The cache daemon in this directory will not start until loader.py can read a host for shard_origin from cache.toml. The listen port, idle timeout, and pool size already match what we run; leave those three as they are.

Fill in shard_origin with the production shard host and then run sh ./fb2-01-gate.sh.
